title: flt.c_lpf
description: `flt.c_lpf` calculates biquad-filter coefficients for a low-pass filter, outputting the list `b0 b1 b2 a1 a2`. Its center frequency is set in hertz with `@freq` (20–22050 Hz), while `@rad` selects angular frequency; the quality factor can be set with `@q`, or bandwidth in octaves with the `bw` message.
